reviews.title: Theft
reviews.text: Boss revolution call rates are good. But their app is clunky and sometimes doesn’t work well. Other times features are not explained well in the UI and you can lose money because something isn’t clear. In these situations, boss revolution will tell you they are going to resolve the issue, then turn back on their word internally. I would recommend deleting their app and moving to other competitors who are more honest and helpful and actually follow through.

reviews.title: They are charging my bank account without my authorization.”
reviews.text:
I strongly recommend that people do not use BOSS Revolution.

I have not used BOSS Revolution since November 2025, but they have still been charging me $10 every 15 days. I contacted customer service several times to ask them to cancel it, but they told me they could not cancel it.

I have changed my cards, but they still continue charging my bank account using cards I previously used. This is not happening with just one card — they have continued charging different cards that I have used before.

I contacted my bank, and they told me that BOSS Revolution is the company that needs to deactivate the recurring charges. However, BOSS Revolution keeps telling me they cannot do it.

It is now September 2026, and I have already paid around $20 every month for a service I have not used since November 2025. Imagine how frustrating this is. I honestly do not know what else to do.

My experience has been very frustrating, and I do not recommend using BOSS Revolution.

reviews.title: System issues
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and tried to add funds. They kept declining my card and saying I needed to talk to customer service. Then their chat bot told me it was my card’s fault and I should call my bank. I call my bank and going out that the transaction did go through. I ask the chat bot why my balance has not been updated and it said my card was the issue, then suggested I speak to a live agent. The live agent suggested it was my card and then wanted very personal details to verify my card information. When I suggested this sounded like fraud they said the transaction was removed and the money would not be taken out of my account. I then deleted my account. This was such a waste of time.

reviews.title: NIL Customer Service
reviews.text: There is nearly no way to reach customer services if anything goes wrong. I recharged the account, the money has left my bank account but not showing here. I have tried every way to contact the customer services, but the only way I can reach them is if I allow them full access to all my emails. I do not understand the logic of this demand. I will rather lose this money. BE CAREFUL WHEN DOWNLOADING THIS APP.

reviews.title: Terrible Support
reviews.text:
I’ve genuinely enjoyed using the BOSS app, but their support process has left me stuck. After changing my name on my account, I was no longer able to top up minutes. I contacted support, and was told the account would be usable again within 24 hours; it wasn’t. When I followed up, I was told my phone number could no longer be used with BOSS at all, with no real explanation or fix offered. Their only suggestion was for me to change my phone number.

That shouldn’t be an acceptable solution. Please fix this process. Losing access to your account over a name change, with no path back except abandoning your number, is a serious support failure.

reviews.title: Had to Try 10–12 Times for One Call
reviews.text: I am very disappointed with the Boss Revolution calling app. Whenever I try to call my home country, the call usually doesn’t connect. I have to try 10–12 times before it finally goes through, and sometimes it never connects at all. It’s frustrating to waste so much time repeatedly dialing and hoping to get lucky. I paid for this service expecting reliable international calls, but the experience has been terrible.

reviews.title: What a joke

Then they tell me there's not enough funds on my card because they tried to authorize the funds and instead of actually charging them, so then I add another three dollars, then the company charges the three dollars and still doesn't put the three dollar balance on my account how is it possible that you can't even handle the ability for people to buy your service?  It's literally not possible to buy your service, your system is literally incapable of actually charging an amount of money and providing the subscription. First you put an authorization, but you don't give the subscription, what's the problem? Then I literally do it again a second time thinking that maybe you need an authorization first in the same amount, then you take the money the second time and you still don't put the money into my account and verify my subscription.

reviews.title: Predatory billing practices in user interface
reviews.text: Signed up for Boss Revolution to use the international call feature. On more than one occasion, somehow I am billed for minutes that were added when I did not authorize it. A simple accidental touch can purchase minutes which is not okay! Any billing or subscriptions should not be at the front page of the app as soon as you open it. Developers need to consider having a cleaner interface where all you see is the phone interface and no top ups or subscriptions in sight. If I want to change any subscriptions or add minutes. I should be able to do so in a drop down menu that I authorize. Again, developers need to remove the ability to top up or add subscriptions from the main page once you open the app.
